subject: Next steps: Security validation & SOC 2 bundle — draft MAP milestone and dates
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wallace <ewallace@healthgrid.com>, Priya Menon <p.menon@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Security validation & SOC 2 bundle — draft MAP milestone and dates

Hi Ethan / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the MAP moving toward your Q2 launch target.

Call highlights
- You'd like a consolidated SOC 2 evidence bundle plus a short questionnaire with owner-level links for review.
- Security review is the gating milestone before procurement begins (legal + SOW).
- Target close: end of May (client target), Redwood target to have security artifacts delivered by 2027-05-10 to allow a 2-week internal review window.

Proposed MAP milestone (attached RG-3479_MAP_v0.2.xlsx)
1) Security intake & questionnaire completed (HealthGrid owners) — due 2027-03-28
2) Redwood delivers initial SOC 2 evidence bundle (DRAFT) — due 2027-04-18
3) HealthGrid security review / comments — due 2027-04-30
4) Final SOC 2 package (signed off) — due 2027-05-10
5) Procurement & SOW execution — target close 2027-05-31

Owners & dependencies
- HealthGrid: complete questionnaire (Priya / Ethan) and provide any environment specifics.
- Redwood: Mina (package assembly), Marissa (evidence collection from infra/team), Aditya (SRE audit notes + retention config).
- Dependency: access to a read-only log-sample or audit summary if HealthGrid requests deeper verification (we can redline before sharing).

Attachments: RG-3479_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (draft MAP milestones), SOC2_Package_DRAFT_v0.1.pdf (table of contents + sample artifact list), security-questionnaire-HealthGrid-filled.xlsx (blank copy for your team).

Action items
- Ethan/Priya: confirm the milestone dates above or propose alternate dates by EOD 2027-03-17.
- Priya: add the two security reviewers' emails so we can include them on the evidence handoff.

I'll stand up the evidence folder and drop the DRAFT package once we confirm dates. Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ethan Wallace <ewallace@healthgrid.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <p.menon@healthgrid.com>, security@healthgrid.com
Date: 2027-03-15T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Security validation & SOC 2 bundle — draft MAP milestone and dates

Mina — thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Quick notes from our side:

- Dates look reasonable overall; the only risk is that our internal security sprint overlaps with 2027-04-20 to 2027-04-25. If Redwood can push the draft bundle by 2027-04-15 (instead of 4/18) that would help.
- We'll assign two reviewers: myself and Rahul Desai (rdesai@healthgrid.com). I'll add Rahul to the distribution list today.
- We may request a redacted log sample for the SRE retention check — we'll confirm in the questionnaire.

Action: I confirm Rahul and I will complete the questionnaire by 2027-03-28. Please let us know if you can shift the Redwood draft bundle date up by three days.

Thanks — Ethan

Team — forwarding HealthGrid confirmation. Key changes: they'd like the draft SOC2 bundle moved up ~3 days (target 2027-04-15) and Rahul Desai is added as second reviewer.

Please own the following:
- Marissa: lead evidence assembly, coordinate with SRE and Product to pull architecture diagram + encryption configs.
- Aditya: produce retention and KV-cache logs summary + the short write-up on access controls (we'll include as a redacted sample).
- Sergio: I'll need you to confirm the internal review cadence and whether we need to spin up a short security readout (30 min walkthrough) during the HealthGrid review window.

I'll update the MAP and reply to Ethan confirming the revised delivery date. If any of these owners can't meet the 4/15 internal deliverable, flag me by EOD 3/17.

Thanks — Mina

Subject: SOC2 package (DRAFT) uploaded — please confirm receipt and review slots

Hi Ethan / Priya / Rahul —

Per our last note, I've uploaded the DRAFT SOC2 package and updated the MAP milestones to reflect the revised delivery date. Attachments in this thread and files in the shared folder: SOC2_Package_DRAFT_v0.1.pdf (TOC + artifact pointers), RG-3479_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (updated dates), security-questionnaire-HealthGrid-filled.xlsx (your copy to complete).

Ask: can you confirm two 30-minute review windows during 2027-04-20 to 2027-04-30 for live Q&A? We can run short walkthroughs and accept comments inline in the shared drive.

Next internal steps (Redwood)
- Marissa to upload remaining infra artifacts by 2027-04-12.
- Aditya to prepare redacted log summary by 2027-04-12.
- Mina to circulate final package for sign-off on 2027-05-10.

Ethan: once you confirm those two review slots we will lock the MAP and start the procurement checklist.

Thanks and looking forward — Mina
